meta.method: Local signal = 30% local pain + 25% inherited economics + 25% geographic concentration + 20% evidence confidence. Over-index = local pain minus the current Toronto parent-opportunity pain score.
meta.evidenceGate: Rank only signals with at least two evidence items and confidence >= 3.5/5. Lower-confidence signals should be shown as insufficient evidence rather than ranked.
meta.warning: Local scores describe the current research evidence and concentration of a pain hypothesis. They are not prevalence estimates or neighbourhood quality scores.
